feature: Branches resolve through full refnames and recorded SHAs
expected: Merges use the recorded SHA, never a bare name that a tag could shadow.
The target is matched exactly against refs/heads.

contains: resolve every branch through its full refname (`refs/heads/<name>`) and record its SHA
`<target>` and `<source>` in a revision argument mean `refs/heads/<name>` or the recorded SHA, never the bare name
Report a same-named tag for any branch, the target included.
`rev-parse` success is not a match (case-insensitive filesystems resolve the wrong case)
Take the SHAs from one `git for-each-ref --format='%(refname) %(objectname)' refs/heads` listing
- **Case collisions**: when two local branch names are equal ignoring case (`Feat` and `feat`), both are `UNKNOWN` whatever else applies
If the target or `main` is one of them, that is a gate failure.
the target or `main` equals another local branch name when case is ignored
(this is decided before the ordered classification below)
run `git pack-refs --all` first (then no name is a loose ref file, so each resolves exactly), rename one with `git branch -m`, and compare both tips with the recorded SHAs
